subtasks.title: REV2 (pure-CH pivot): read hotlist client/lienholder lists from ClickHouse (clarity.hotlist) instead of the slow Postgres read-replica; keep cache()->flexible() + a ClickHouse-failure resilience catch
subtasks.approach: REVISION 2 — Dalton pivoted mid-review from the Postgres catch-only mitigation to reading these lists from ClickHouse. Rewrite Org::getHotlistClients()/getHotlistLienholders() so the cache()->flexible([now()->endOfDay(), now()->addDay()->endOfDay()], fn) closure queries App\Clickhouse\Models\Hotlist (connection clarity_clickhouse; ApplyFinal + FiltersCdcDeletes global scopes ALREADY applied by the model) for DISTINCT client_org_id + client_org_name (lienholder variant: lienholder_org_id + lienholder_org_name), filtering: where('org_id',$this->id), whereNotNull(id col), AND whereNotNull(name col) + name != '' (live-verified ~0.17% of client rows have null/empty name — filtering avoids blank dropdown options), orderBy(name), then pluck(name, id) -> same Illuminate\Support\Collection<int,string> [id=>name] shape all ~9 callers expect. Broaden the resilience catch from Postgres QueryException(57014) to LaravelClickhouseEloquent\Exceptions\ClickhouseException (query no longer hits Postgres; a CH outage/timeout must still degrade gracefully): catch around cache()->flexible(); if config('app.debug') rethrow, else Log::channel('db-error')->error('...',['org_id'=>$this->id,...]) + logDatadogCount('clarity.query_timeout',1,['category'=>'database_timeout','item'=>'hotlist_clients_cache_warm'|'hotlist_lienholders_cache_warm']) and return collect(). REMOVE the obsolete isStatementTimeout()/57014 helper + the Illuminate\Database\QueryException import (no Postgres query anymore); import LaravelClickhouseEloquent\Exceptions\ClickhouseException + keep Log. Keep flexible() so a warmed org serves stale over empty. Do NOT change the ~9 callers. TDD: rewrite tests for the CH source (happy path seeds CH via Database\Factories\Clickhouse\HotlistFactory and asserts the [id=>name] result incl. name-null filtering; resilience mocks the clarity_clickhouse connection to throw ClickhouseException -> asserts empty degrade + rethrow-in-debug; keep the flexible stale-serve test). Needs local Docker ClickHouse (re-provisioned QA_PROVISION_CH=yes).
subtasks.intended_diffs: Org.php: +2 imports; +1 private isStatementTimeout() helper; each getter's `return cache()->remember(...)` wrapped in try/catch that logs+returns collect() on a 57014 timeout (non-debug) and rethrows otherwise. Tests: add a timeout-path test to each job test file (force the zod connection select to throw a QueryException whose message contains 'statement timeout'; Config::set('app.debug', false); assert the job completes without throwing and cache()->get(key) stays null); new tests/Models/OrgHotlistCacheTest.php asserting a direct getHotlistClients()/getHotlistLienholders() call returns an empty Collection on timeout (protects the ~9 Filament/console callers), that a non-timeout QueryException still propagates, and that the happy path (real data) still returns the correct [id=>name] Collection.
